content: K8s support-bundle ecosystem: Troubleshoot.sh collect+analyze specs; Rancher support-bundle-kit simulator; newer tools export recovery-report.md offline from .tar.gz (heuristic findings + Markdown). Pattern for Go CLIs: offline archive ingest, deterministic heuristics, Markdown/JSON dual export, no live cluster. Groot should stay evidence-first heuristics on its own archive layout, not Troubleshoot compatibility.
